units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Okay. Full. Happy. A bit sticky.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: A good day, then. A museum with a Rembrandt cut to fit a wall, a lawn with a missing sign, a street market with warm waffles, a brewery with a haystack in its past, and a plate of ribs.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: And no one got run over by a bike.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Not yet. The walk home is still ahead.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Look both ways. Then look again.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Then look up, because the next bicycle might come from the sky.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: In Amsterdam, you can never be sure.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Thank you for walking with us.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: If you'd like another tour, ask for one.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: There's a night walk through the old center, for the spooky side of the city.
